text: Steenbarger, on WCN: I abstained, so I set no horizon; I cannot say which of horizon_sessions 30 or 20 the deciders filed and I defer to decision.json as the filed record. My objection stands: elder_5d [7, 7, 7, 7, 10] carries no bar at 6 or below, so no permission event (C4), and no CORRECTION_REENTRY, so no R8. A high plateau is summer, not the buying season (C20); acting on it is the C24 unsourced read. Elder stands aside (C22). What clears it: a pullback printing a daily elder 6 or below, then 7 or above, then the trigger.
